title: Basic Block Splitting
description: Basic Block Splitting is a analysis ability in the Control Flow Graph (CFG) Extraction database. Splits code into basic blocks — straight-line sequences. Leaders are found at jumps and targets; blocks run between leaders. It takes code and produces blocks. Tunable parameters: per function. Guarantee: every instruction lands in exactly one block.

fields.mechanism: Leaders are found at jumps and targets; blocks run between leaders.
fields.guarantees: every instruction lands in exactly one block

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Edge Construction
description: Edge Construction is a analysis ability in the Control Flow Graph (CFG) Extraction database. Connects blocks with edges for every possible jump. Jumps, branches, and fall-throughs each become edges. It takes blocks and produces edges. Tunable parameters: complete. Guarantee: no possible jump is ever missing.

fields.mechanism: Jumps, branches, and fall-throughs each become edges.
fields.guarantees: no possible jump is ever missing

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Loop Detection
description: Loop Detection is a analysis ability in the Control Flow Graph (CFG) Extraction database. Finds loops as back edges in the graph. Depth-first search finds edges to ancestors; each marks a loop. It takes graph and produces loops. Tunable parameters: DFS. Guarantee: nested loops are always found.

fields.mechanism: Depth-first search finds edges to ancestors; each marks a loop.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Branch Mapping
description: Branch Mapping is a analysis ability in the Control Flow Graph (CFG) Extraction database. Maps each branch condition to its true/false edges. Conditions attach to their branch node; edges are labeled. It takes branches and produces labeled edges. Tunable parameters: per branch. Guarantee: every branch gets both edges.

fields.mechanism: Conditions attach to their branch node; edges are labeled.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Unreachable Code
description: Unreachable Code is a analysis ability in the Control Flow Graph (CFG) Extraction database. Finds blocks no path from entry can reach. Reachability from entry marks live blocks; the rest are dead. It takes graph and produces dead blocks. Tunable parameters: from entry. Guarantee: dead blocks are always reported.

fields.mechanism: Reachability from entry marks live blocks; the rest are dead.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Dominance Trees
description: Dominance Trees is a analysis ability in the Control Flow Graph (CFG) Extraction database. Computes which blocks dominate which others. Dominators are the blocks every path passes through; the tree aids optimization. It takes graph and produces tree. Tunable parameters: per block. Guarantee: the entry always dominates all.

fields.mechanism: Dominators are the blocks every path passes through; the tree aids optimization.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Path Enumeration
description: Path Enumeration is a analysis ability in the Control Flow Graph (CFG) Extraction database. Lists all paths through small functions. Paths are enumerated depth-first with a cap; loops unroll once. It takes graph and produces paths. Tunable parameters: capped. Guarantee: enumeration never hangs on loops.

fields.mechanism: Paths are enumerated depth-first with a cap; loops unroll once.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Call Graphs
description: Call Graphs is a analysis ability in the Control Flow Graph (CFG) Extraction database. Links function calls into a whole-program graph. Call sites resolve to targets; the graph spans the program. It takes functions and produces call graph. Tunable parameters: per call. Guarantee: indirect calls are always marked uncertain.

fields.mechanism: Call sites resolve to targets; the graph spans the program.
fields.guarantees: indirect calls are always marked uncertain

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Exception Edges
description: Exception Edges is a analysis ability in the Control Flow Graph (CFG) Extraction database. Adds edges for exception throws and catches. Throw sites link to handlers; uncaught throws link to exit. It takes code and produces edges. Tunable parameters: per throw. Guarantee: no throw edge is ever missing.

fields.mechanism: Throw sites link to handlers; uncaught throws link to exit.
fields.guarantees: no throw edge is ever missing

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Graph Visualization
description: Graph Visualization is a analysis ability in the Control Flow Graph (CFG) Extraction database. Draws the CFG so humans can read it. Blocks render as boxes and edges as arrows with labels. It takes graph and produces diagram. Tunable parameters: per function. Guarantee: layouts never overlap blocks.

fields.mechanism: Blocks render as boxes and edges as arrows with labels.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Complexity Metrics
description: Complexity Metrics is a analysis ability in the Control Flow Graph (CFG) Extraction database. Computes cyclomatic complexity from the graph. Complexity is edges minus nodes plus two; hot functions flag. It takes graph and produces number. Tunable parameters: per function. Guarantee: the math is always exact.

fields.mechanism: Complexity is edges minus nodes plus two; hot functions flag.

demo.code:
function paths(depth){return Math.pow(2,depth);}
console.log('Paths at depth 33: '+paths(3));

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Dataflow on CFG
description: Dataflow on CFG is a analysis ability in the Control Flow Graph (CFG) Extraction database. Runs reaching-definitions analysis over the graph. Definitions propagate along edges; uses see their reaching defs. It takes graph and produces facts. Tunable parameters: per block. Guarantee: facts never cross impossible edges.

fields.mechanism: Definitions propagate along edges; uses see their reaching defs.

demo.code:
function paths(depth){return Math.pow(2,depth);}

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Interprocedural CFGs
description: Interprocedural CFGs is a analysis ability in the Control Flow Graph (CFG) Extraction database. Builds graphs that span function calls. Call and return edges connect function graphs into one. It takes functions and produces one graph. Tunable parameters: per program. Guarantee: recursion is always handled.

fields.mechanism: Call and return edges connect function graphs into one.

demo.code:
function paths(depth){return Math.pow(2,depth);}

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: CFG Diffing
description: CFG Diffing is a analysis ability in the Control Flow Graph (CFG) Extraction database. Diffs two versions' graphs to show control changes. Graphs align by block content; changed edges highlight. It takes versions and produces diff. Tunable parameters: per function. Guarantee: diffs never miss an added branch.

fields.mechanism: Graphs align by block content; changed edges highlight.
fields.guarantees: diffs never miss an added branch

fields.mechanism: All formats derive from one model; content matches.
